title: Explore Blending Modes in Photoshop - Day 18 (PHLEARN)
summary: In this PHLEARN tutorial, Day 18 of 30 Days of Photoshop systematically demonstrates blending modes and their practical uses. The instructor places blending modes into groups (Normal, Darken, Lighten, Overlay, and the Calculation family) and explains when each group is typically useful. Through a series of non-destructive, hands-on edits, he shows how to composite images, colorize light and color information, and creatively grade with gradient maps. Key techniques include: converting imported images to smart objects for non-destructive edits; using Levels to white out or darken backgrounds in conjunction with Multiply or Screen blend modes; leveraging light leaks and bokeh overlays with Screen or Lighten-based blends; and using gradient maps and Hue/Saturation to color-grade and harmonize a final image. The session emphasizes practical workflow over memorizing every mode, and demonstrates fast iteration with keyboard shortcuts to cycle blending modes.
